reason: The plugin is a DeepSeek Harness add-on focused on memory/context continuity, exposing prior-session references through an @ menu and inserting them into the current chat via a dedicated UI capsule with bounded serialization and size/count limits, rather than code generation or workflow automation.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可安装的跨会话引用能力，让用户在输入时从 @ 菜单选择历史会话并将引用内容插入当前对话。
summaries.en: This plugin adds installable cross-session reference support for DeepSeek Harness, letting users choose prior sessions from an @ menu and insert those references into the current conversation.

capabilities: Adds cross-session reference selection via an @ input menu.
Inserts selected references into the input surface using a capsule-style UI element.
Serializes references with a `dsh-session:` mention format for copy, persistence, and submission.
Applies limits on reference count and source byte size at plugin/runtime boundaries.

reasons.code: README states the plugin is a read-only cross-session reference bundle with @ menu access and send-time context projection.
README documents bounded usage defaults (three references per message, 65,536 UTF-8 bytes per source) indicating controlled data handling limits.
package.json declares integration points with DSH session, session-query, runtime, and UI/input-trigger components for context retrieval and insertion.
